title: Not good for poached eggs
text: Not good for poached eggs. I was disappointed with this pan because I was purposely looking for a pan to poach eggs, which the description of the pan stayed was one of its uses. It’s very shallow - only about 3/8”, not enough to poach an egg. It is very sturdy.
